query: I'm making a low-poly Godot dungeon crawler. Find me a stone wall texture for the corridors and put it in res://textures at 512px.
expected_behavior: Runs ab status before searching, and uses --semantic only if the index is reported available
Searches with a description plus --type tex and --sheet, then reads the sheet PNG before choosing
Runs ab inspect on the chosen id and mentions powerOfTwo / dimensions in the decision
Exports with --to <project>/textures --resize 512 and reports the absolute output path
Tells the user the export was recorded in assets-used.json

query: Add a door-opening sound to the Phaser game in this folder. Keep it short and trim any silence.
expected_behavior: Searches audio by description (or name search with a short query if semantic is unavailable)
Uses ab inspect to check seconds / trimmed duration before exporting
Exports with --trim-silence (and --range if the clip is long) into the project's audio folder
Does not overwrite an existing file without --yes; asks or renames instead

query: I liked the barrel prop you added earlier (id 9b986df547746312). Find a few more props in the same style as OBJ for my Three.js scene.
expected_behavior: Uses ab search --similar 9b986df547746312 --type model rather than a new text query
Renders a sheet and picks by looking
Exports with --format obj and notes that the .mtl came along; if a model has no OBJ variant, reports the available formats from the exit-4 message instead of failing silently

query: My platformer needs footstep sounds on wood: four separate single steps, all at the same loudness, in assets/sfx/steps.
expected_behavior: Searches audio and renders an audio sheet (about 6 rows), then reads it, using the spectrogram and the numbered bands rather than file names alone
Picks a multi-step take and runs ab inspect to get its segments before exporting
Exports single steps with --segment N (or --segment all, then keeps four) rather than guessing --range values
Uses --normalize so the steps match, and reports any peak-ceiling warning
Checks at least one exported file with ab inspect <path> and mentions assets-used.json
